idea: A tool that helps small cafes predict how much stock to order each week, using their till data and the weather forecast.
An app for flatmates to split shared bills and settle up automatically.
A cash flow forecast for UK small businesses that connects to their bank via open banking and warns them 30 days before they run short.
Reduce missed appointments at physiotherapy clinics with smart reminders and an easy rebooking flow.
An internal assistant that lets employees raise and track IT requests in plain English from Slack.
